QuestInfo.name: [Icy Onslaught] The Source of the Invasion
QuestInfo.1: #p9400350# thanks you for recovering the #i4036052# #t4036052#. \r\nYou should tell him what you learned from #p9400361#.
QuestInfo.2:
#p9400350# thanks you for recovering the #i4036052# #t4036052#. and you told him what you learned from #p9400361#. 
The invading Frost Fiends are from another world.
#p9400350# had no trouble believing this, as contrary to most of the lifeforms of Maple World, the Frost Fiends are at home in the cold, and even seem to carry it with them.
#p9400350# said they would send the #i4036052# #t4036052# to Grendel for a magical analysis.
